qualification_source_identity_method: tests/cuda_reference_regression.py source_files/fingerprint; includes current implementation and test tooling. Final Mac source, Linux source and both package source snapshots matched.
production_source_identity_method: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON mapping Makefile, scripts/embed_model_catalog.py and src files with .c/.h/.m/.mm/.cu/.cuh/.metal/.json/.inc suffixes to SHA-256; generated native_attention.inc excluded. Both package source snapshots matched this production file set.

scope.native_generation: 14 functional cases per backend, plus two 50-step 8 MP quality cases on CUDA; all 50 DiT blocks are active for every case.
scope.timing: seconds includes the generation process and excludes subsequent codec-only verification; wall_seconds is the C harness timer. CUDA profile walls are cumulative per context. Memory samples are observed peaks, not minimum hardware requirements.
scope.identities: Native campaigns were staged during implementation and record binary identities at campaign completion. Final source and packaged regressions qualify the integrated production code. Model identities are catalog pins; the qualification does not hash installed model weight payloads.
scope.limits: Direct 8,425,472-pixel landscape and portrait generation is tested on both devices. The 16,777,216-pixel policy boundary has host admission coverage only. Metal 50-step quality and still acceleration/LoRA policies are not qualified here.
scope.sampling: Existing h3cli Euler/shifted-flow sampler, not ComfyUI er_sde/simple trajectory equivalence.

verification.host_suites: make test-current-host and make test-still-sanitize passed; both full host suites rerun after minimal-model startup correction.
metal: independent F32 reference: four fixtures, including three-way overlap
source and standalone offline generation from 53-file models without audio/image VAEs
cuda: ASan/UBSan host and compute-sanitizer GPU guards
final immutable 204-output native and standalone regressions
source and standalone offline generation from 53-file models without audio/image VAEs
offline standalone base/reference VAE-only decode and reference generation

linux_launcher_host.skip_reason: No /dev/shm noexec mount; that mount-specific test is unverified, not counted as a pass.

verification.lora_clone_coverage: Host filesystem-dependent clone coverage is supplemented by the mandatory current CUDA suite on XFS; skipped clone tests are rejected by that runner.
